mechanism: Amphetamine may increase psychomotor agitation and cardiovascular stress while methotrexate causes immunosuppression and potential CNS toxicity; amphetamine can also increase renal tubular reabsorption affecting methotrexate clearance.
action: Monitor for increased agitation, insomnia, and cardiovascular effects; ensure adequate hydration and consider dosage adjustment or alternative ADHD therapy; regular renal function monitoring recommended.
